caption:
How do you hack an AI? Not with complex code, but with plain English.

OpenAI highlighted prompt injection as a frontier security challenge. When language models process untrusted text from web pages or documents, hidden instructions can trick the AI into overriding its system rules.

As AI agents gain real-world capabilities—like reading emails and managing tasks—securing these natural language boundaries is becoming critical for safe deployment.

Swipe through for the breakdown on how prompt injection works and how OpenAI is addressing it.
